preToolUse.command: if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND:-}" | grep -Eq '^(npm|pnpm|yarn|cargo|pytest|jest)'; then if [ -z "$TMUX" ]; then echo '[Compat] Recommend tmux for long-running command resilience.' >&2; fi; fi

postToolUse.command: if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_PATH:-}" | grep -Eq '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then if grep -n 'console\.log' "${TOOL_INPUT_PATH}" 2>/dev/null; then echo '[Compat] console.log detected; replace with project logger when possible.' >&2; fi; fi || true
if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_PATH:-}" | grep -Eq '^src/(api|types)/.*\.ts$'; then echo '[Compat] API/type changed. Consider /sync to update specs/docs.' >&2; fi
if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_PATH:-}" | grep -Eqi '(auth|payment|admin|security)'; then echo '[Compat] Sensitive area touched. Consider /review --security-only.' >&2; fi
